description: This file defines classes, structs, and functions related to the runtime execution of JIT graphs in PyTorch, including GraphExecutor, ExecutionPlan, and profiling controls.

classes.name: ExecutionPlan
classes.description: Represents a compiled execution plan for a graph, including the code and the graph itself.

classes.name: GraphExecutorState
classes.description: Holds the state of a GraphExecutor, including the associated graph, fallback plan, and execution plans.

classes.name: EnableProfilingGuard
classes.description: RAII guard to enable profiling within a scope.

classes.name: GraphExecutor
classes.description: Main class responsible for executing JIT graphs, supporting synchronous and asynchronous runs, and retrieving debug information.

classes.name: GraphOptimizerEnabledGuard
classes.description: RAII guard to enable or disable graph optimizer.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the graph with given inputs.

methods.name: getPlanFor
methods.description: Retrieves the execution plan for given inputs, considering bailout depth.

methods.name: getDebugState
methods.description: Returns the current debug state of the GraphExecutor.

methods.name: debugFlushCompilationCache
methods.description: Flushes the compilation cache for debugging.

methods.name: isOptimized
methods.description: Checks if the graph is optimized.
